input.quote: The Agreement may be renewed for an additional period of seven (7) years at the option of the Licensor.
input.rationale:
Article IV grants Licensor a unilateral option to extend the 36-month Initial Period by a further seven years, with no Licensee consent right, no non-renewal notice mechanism and no limit on fee increases for the extension period. A Licensor-controlled multi-year renewal is a walk-away item under the playbook (automatic multi-year renewals) and is also inconsistent with clauses II and III of the same Article, which contemplate extension only by mutual written agreement. Redline sets renewal to mutual written 12-month increments, requires 60 days' notice of renewal and any fee change, and caps renewal uplift at the lesser of CPI and 3%; fallback is 12-month automatic renewal with 30-day (max 60-day) opt-out and a 5% cap.</rationale>
<parameter name="confidence">0.9

ops.oldText: The Agreement may be renewed for an additional period of seven (7) years at the option of the Licensor.
ops.newText: The Agreement may be renewed for successive additional periods of up to twelve (12) months each only upon the mutual written agreement of the parties, and Licensor shall notify Licensee of any proposed renewal and of any proposed change in fees at least sixty (60) days prior to the expiration of the then-current period. Fees for any renewal period shall not increase over the fees in effect during the immediately preceding period by more than the lesser of (a) the percentage increase in the U.S. Consumer Price Index over that period and (b) three percent (3%).

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a seven-year extension exercisable at Licensor's sole option, which would lock us in for a multi-year term with uncapped fees. Consistent with clauses II and III of this Article, renewal should occur only by mutual written agreement in 12-month increments, with 60 days' advance notice of renewal and any fee change and renewal uplift capped at the lesser of CPI and 3%. If Licensor prefers automatic renewal, we can accept 12-month automatic renewals that we may exit on 30 days' notice, with uplift capped at 5%.
proposal.summary: Replace Licensor's unilateral 7-year renewal option with mutual written 12-month renewals, 60-day renewal/fee-change notice, and a CPI/3% uplift cap.
